description: Southern Province Province Council - Notify the Annual Licence fee for renewing Pawnbroking Business
reasoning: This gazette notification primarily concerns the amendment of a legal/regulatory framework - specifically, the Pawnbrokers' Statute No. 01 of 2013 of the Southern Provincial Council. It invalidates a previous fee structure and establishes a new annual license fee for pawnbroking businesses. While it mentions the Chief Minister's authority, the core content is regulatory in nature, dealing with statutory instruments and compliance requirements for commercial activities, which falls under Legal/Regulatory classification rather than government personnel or structural changes.
